     from inspect import iscoroutinefunction
 else:  # pragma: no cover
     from asyncio import iscoroutinefunction

+def _get_call_levels(call: Any) -> List[Any]:
+    """
+    Collect every level of a callable chain: partials (``.func``), wrappers
+    (``__wrapped__``, e.g. from functools.wraps) and instance ``__call__``
+    methods, so that async/generator detection looks at all of them.
+    """
+    levels: List[Any] = []
+    seen: set = set()
+    stack: List[Any] = [call]
+    while stack:
+        obj = stack.pop()
+        if obj is None or id(obj) in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(id(obj))
+        levels.append(obj)
+        if isinstance(obj, partial):
+            stack.append(obj.func)
+            continue
+        wrapped = getattr(obj, "__wrapped__", None)
+        if wrapped is not None:
+            stack.append(wrapped)
+            continue
+        if inspect.isroutine(obj) or inspect.isclass(obj):
+            continue
+        dunder_call = getattr(obj, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
+        if inspect.ismethod(dunder_call) or inspect.isfunction(dunder_call):
+            stack.append(dunder_call)
+    return levels
